channel.title: mint - companies
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: ‘A good idea’: Elon Musk says special committees will discuss Tesla and SpaceX merger while he sits out
item.description: Tesla and SpaceX have formed independent special committees to consider a potential merger that could create a company valued at about $3.5 trillion. Elon Musk says he will not participate in committee discussions, and stressed that no deal has been agreed and a merger may never happen.

item.title: Iveco's minority shareholders emerge as key hurdle to Tata’s takeover bid
item.description: Tata Motors must secure silent shareholders vote to complete €3.9 billion Iveco acquisition.

item.title: Buoyed by blockbuster IPO, ESDS bets on AI chip rentals for $5 billion revenue scope in 5 years
item.description: In an interview with Mint, CMD Piyush Somani laid out an ambitious AI chip rental strategy to drive growth. But compounding revenue 2.5 times every year remains a rare feat, even in tech.

item.title: Match Group eyes India growth even as dating-app scams raise safety concerns
item.description: The Tinder owner says scams and fake accounts are among its most prominent user complaints, but does not disclose India-specific safety spending, scam reports or revenue

item.title: Ammonium nitrate to PETN: CCPA cracks down on 7 online platforms over explosive listings; 3,940 sellers delisted
item.description: The platforms named by the authority are IndiaMART, TradeIndia, Dial4Trade, Justdial, Sigma-Aldrich India, ExportersIndia and Ibuychemikals.

item.title: Closed College Campus in Boston Suburb to Sell for $21 Million
item.description: A Boston suburb’s housing authority is planning to buy the campus of Eastern Nazarene College, which closed last year, for $21 million.

item.title: Citi Mexico sees new opportunities with banks after Banamex split
item.description: CITI-MEXICO/:Citi Mexico sees new opportunities with banks after Banamex split

item.title: Instacart settles federal claims of discrimination against US-born job seekers
item.description: Instacart settles federal claims of discrimination against US-born job seekers

item.title: Who is Sharad Mathur? Meet IndusInd General Insurance's new MD and CEO tasked with driving growth and transformation
item.description: Sharad Mathur has been appointed Managing Director and CEO of IndusInd General Insurance Company Ltd. Mathur has held senior leadership positions at Universal Sompo General Insurance, SBI General Insurance and ICICI Lombard.

item.title: Who is Joel Kaplan? Meta's Chief Global Affairs Officer to leave in 2027 after nearly 16 years at the company
item.description: Meta says Chief Global Affairs Officer Joel Kaplan will leave in 2027, after the US midterm elections. A longtime Republican adviser, Kaplan joined the company in 2011 and took charge of global policy shortly before Donald Trump began his second presidential term.

item.title: Amazon plans to recruit over 300,000 workers for holiday season, up 20% from 2025; check wages for seasonal workers
item.description: Amazon plans to hire more than 300,000 workers for the holiday season, a 20% increase from last year. The company will offer temporary staff an average wage of $20 per hour and medical benefits for some who continue working in January, even as overall retail hiring is expected to decline.

item.title: Who is Harish Bhat? Why the Tata veteran resigned from Trent's board and what he told Noel Tata
item.description: Harish Bhat submitted his resignation to Chairman Noel Tata recently. He stepped down from the Board of Directors of Trent Ltd as per the documents.

item.title: Akash Ambani: from building Jio to selling its story
item.description: As Jio prepares for India's biggest IPO, chairman Akash Ambani must convince investors that he can do more than carry forward his father’s legacy—that he can turn Jio’s extraordinary scale into enduring value for millions of shareholders.

item.title: Schaeffler India CEO Harsha Gopal Kadam taken into custody over factory accident that killed 2 workers
item.description: Kadam was taken into custody late Monday by the Talegaon MIDC Police Station for investigation into the incident at the company's factory premises in Talegaon, Pune, on June 9, 2026, the company said.

item.title: Who is Eric Schmidt? Meet ex-Google CEO whose 1% Anthropic stake could push his fortune close to $80 billion
item.description: Former Google CEO Eric Schmidt reportedly owns about 1% of Anthropic after investing tens of millions of dollars in its 2021 Series A. Based on a possible Anthropic valuation of $2 trillion, his stake could add roughly one-third to his net worth, taking it close to $80 billion.

item.title: Qualcomm layoffs: Chipmaker to cut jobs globally from November after performance reviews
item.description: Qualcomm will cut jobs globally after annual performance reviews, with notifications starting in November, CEO Cristiano Amon told employees in a memo reviewed by Reuters. The company has not disclosed the number of roles affected as it shifts focus towards AI data centres.

item.title: Who is Priya S Kapur? How she honoured late husband Sunjay with bronze sculpture at Sona Comstar | Video
item.description: Priya S Kapur unveiled a bronze sculpture at Sona Comstar in tribute to her late husband, industrialist Sunjay Kapur. She remembered his vision and courage in transforming the company from a single-product business into a technology-driven enterprise.

item.title: Flipkart to challenge Zomato and Swiggy with ‘Eat-in by Minutes’: Launch date, features explained
item.description: Flipkart is testing its food-delivery service, Eat-in by Minutes, with around 8,000 employees in Bengaluru ahead of a public launch expected by the end of October 2026.

item.title: Meet Akash Ramdas and Advaith Sridhar: AI startup founders who raised $9 million to discover new semiconductor materials
item.description: The San Francisco-based start-up is the latest, planning to use swarms of AI agents to accelerate the discovery of semiconductor materials that could help address the “major heat problem” for AI chips.

item.title: Former Swiggy CTO’s trading app Sahi eyes up to $50 mn at $500 mn valuation
item.description: Founder Dale Vaz is betting on single-screen trading technology and discounted ₹10 F&amp;O pricing to build Sahi into a serious contender against incumbent discount brokers such as Groww and Zerodha.

item.title: Italian penmaker Montegrappa launches limited-edition Miura-inspired pen priced at nearly ₹8.79 lakh: Check features
item.description: Lamborghini and Montegrappa have unveiled a limited-edition pen marking the Miura’s 60th anniversary. Available in fountain pen and rollerball versions, it features a retractable rock-crystal headlight and comes in three colours. Deliveries are expected to begin in mid-November.

item.title: Elon Musk’s $10.5 bn SpaceX giveaway, Anthropic’s 5% share fund: How will gifts work? Who pays tax? Scenarios explained
item.description: Elon Musk plans to give every US child a SpaceX share, worth $10.5bn. Anthropic is setting aside 5% for a public fund. Here is how tax could work.

item.title: Who is Lily Vadera? HDFC Bank reappoints former RBI executive director as Kaizad Bharucha seeks departure
item.description: HDFC Bank’s board has approved Lily Vadera’s reappointment as an independent director for three years, from November 2026 to November 2029, subject to shareholder approval.&nbsp;

item.title: Cloudera settles lawsuit with Trump admin, agrees to pay $2 mn, faces a two-year PERM ban: All you need to know
item.description: California-based Cloudera agreed to a $2 million settlement over allegations of discrimination against US workers and a two-year ban from the PERM green card programme. The deal includes $1.4 million in back pay and $600,000 in penalties.

item.title: IDBI Bank sale: Who is EAS Sarma? Activist & former civil servant asking President to reconsider lender's privatisation
item.description: Former civil servant EAS Sarma urged the President to reconsider the proposed IDBI Bank sale to Fairfax and seek an independent inquiry. He argued the process lacks transparency, may undervalue public assets and impacts the lender’s development and welfare roles as a CPSE.&nbsp;

item.title: More bad news for Starlink? After India, Ukraine controversies, European telcos plan to launch own satellite service
item.description: Europe’s four largest telecom companies are exploring plans to launch their own satellite mobile services to reduce reliance on Elon Musk’s Starlink amid rising geopolitical tensions. Starlink has also faced controversies involving India and Ukraine.

item.title: Anthropic eyes second $45 billion Nscale deal as 460MW AI data centre plans advance ahead of potential IPO
item.description: Anthropic is negotiating a second potential $45 billion computing deal with Nscale for a 460MW West Virginia data centre as both firms pursue IPO ambitions.

item.title: Tesla sets December vote on Elon Musk’s CEO role & his $158 billion pay package; SpaceX merger stays off ballot
item.description: Tesla’s 2026 proxy seeks Musk’s re-election and a vote on his $158 billion reported pay package, but includes no SpaceX merger proposal.

item.title: How the Polycab case exposes the misuse of IBC for small dues
item.description: Insolvency proceedings over minor vendor claims can exert commercial pressure on financially sound companies, even as courts warn against using the bankruptcy code as a debt-recovery tool.

item.title: California settles 23andMe data breach claims for $6 million
item.description: 23ANDME-BANKRUPTCY/SETTLEMENT (PIX):California settles 23andMe data breach claims for $6 million

item.title: Why is Amazon threatening to axe 5,000 delivery jobs over Zohran Mamdani’s labour law in New York? What govt can do
item.description: Amazon has warned that it could cut over 5,000 delivery jobs and close 15 New York City facilities if Mayor Zohran Mamdani’s proposed Delivery Protection Act becomes law. The bill would require direct employment of drivers, prompting concerns over job losses, delivery costs and worker protections.

item.title: Walmart seeks $2.5 billion from US bond sale, weighs first Canadian-dollar offering
item.description: Retail giant attracts over $14 billion in demand for US debt as spending plans and funding diversification drive borrowing strategy

item.title: Vinted Cracks Down on Looted Goods After French Riots
item.description: Vinted, a secondhand online marketplace that counts France as one of its largest markets, has seen an influx of listings suspected to contain looted items after riots broke out across the country.

item.title: 'Indian startup ecosystem is on steroids' - Anand Mahindra shares what excites him most, says my salute to them
item.description: Anand Mahindra praised India’s startup ecosystem, highlighting companies including Ethereal Machines, Pranos Fusion Energy and Scimplify. He said young entrepreneurs are developing advanced manufacturing, fusion and chemical technologies that could help India leapfrog stages of development.

item.title: Bajaj Finance to shrink lending to reckless borrowers
item.description: Bajaj Finance is halving the share of new loans to customers with three or more lending relationships to 3.5% by March 2027 amid concerns indebtedness.
